parent_objective: design the next source-fidelity branch after current single-track/proxy-fault source mining remains zero-accepted
blocked_by: M1264 pivots from current-model richer proxy faults to fidelity fault source design
supersedes: another current-model proxy-fault repair without a source-fidelity design

public_gates: M1265 must preserve actor input contract
M1265 must not use private holdout
M1265 must define the minimum next source-fidelity branch before implementation
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters, fault labels, oracle outcomes, or search outputs to actor inputs
do not claim current single-track proxies are true single-wheel or per-wheel faults
do not choose an external simulator without a bounded integration/validation plan

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a new source-fidelity branch after current-model proxy fault source mining remains zero-accepted
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, high-fidelity-result, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the design proposes another single-track proxy-only source run without a new fidelity variable
stop if the design lowers accepted-source thresholds
stop if the design cannot bound implementation and validation work
fallback_plan: if full high-fidelity integration is too large, design the smallest in-repo four-wheel/fault source pilot
if in-repo four-wheel dynamics is too speculative, design an external-engine comparison/integration scout
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1264 opens the fidelity fault source design branch

admission_evidence: M1264 closed current richer proxy-fault branch
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next implementation or scout manifest if design admits it
next_stage_criteria: design separates in-repo pilot from external simulator validation
design preserves strict source acceptance and actor input guardrails

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1265 designs source fidelity and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source-positive cases exist
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Use M1264 synthesis as the reason to change source-fidelity branch instead of repairing fixed public rows.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, true high-fidelity fault result, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A source-fidelity design can identify a bounded next branch that is more likely to produce true capability-separable rows than more current-model proxy-fault repair.
success_criteria: design explains why current single-track/proxy source is insufficient
design separates minimum in-repo four-wheel/fault pilot from external high-fidelity simulator validation
design defines source acceptance gates and guardrails
design pre-registers the next bounded implementation or scout if admitted
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design proposes another current-model proxy-only run without a new fidelity variable
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1265 passes if it defines the next fidelity-source branch with bounded implementation/scout criteria and no training or threshold relaxation.
